prompt: Turn the person in this portrait into the character below, keeping exactly the same pixel-art style, outline weight, shading, pose, framing, lighting and flat dark background, with the same large, clearly drawn eyes, strong brows and defined mouth: a solemn, studious young scribe of twenty-three, an adult, of medium build, with a soft round face: full cheeks gone thin, a strong straight nose, thick dark-red brows drawn together, large earnest dark-brown eyes behind round wire spectacles with clear lenses, one lens cracked across, full lips pressed into a firm line. Long, thick, wavy rust-red hair loose past her shoulders, tucked behind her ear. A torn scribe's habit of dark slate-grey wool blotted with ink, a pale torn patch on the breast, the high collar torn open at the throat. Black veins like spidery lines of ink branch up the front of her throat to her jaw. Her ink-blackened fingers grip a wooden staff at the edge of the frame, a small bronze censer hanging from its hooked top. Head and shoulders, her whole body, shoulders and face turned three-quarters toward the right, looking right, her head filling most of the frame; large, clearly drawn eyes, strong dark brows, a large defined mouth, bold dark outlines. A plain, flat, empty dark background. Lighting: a soft, dim warm amber rim light from the right, its lamp far out of frame and never visible, gentle warm fill, deep warm brown shadows. A plain dark background with no lamp, lantern or light source in the frame.
